connector.name: Arcadia Finance
connector.registryDescription: Concentrated liquidity on Uniswap/Aerodrome (rebalance, compound, leverage) or single-sided lending.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.arcadia.finance over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the arcadia-finance account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Comma-separated allowed Origin headers for CORS and DNS rebinding protection. Only used when TRANSPORT=http.

env.name: RATE_LIMIT_RPM
env.description: Max requests per minute per session (default 60). Only used when TRANSPORT=http.
